### Operational Summary

Across all **328,521 departed flights** originating from New York City (JFK, LGA, EWR) in 2013, the majority left within standard operating windows:

```{=html}
<div class="row text-center g-3 my-3">
  <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">On-Time / Early</div>
      <div class="kpi-value text-success">60.9%</div>
      <div class="kpi-subtext">200,089 flights (&le; 0 min)</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">Minor Delay</div>
      <div class="kpi-value" style="color: #287D9B;">17.6%</div>
      <div class="kpi-subtext">57,658 flights (1–15 min)</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">FAA Delayed</div>
      <div class="kpi-value text-warning">21.5%</div>
      <div class="kpi-subtext">70,774 flights (&gt; 15 min)</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
    <div class="kpi-card">
      <div class="kpi-label">Severe Delay</div>
      <div class="kpi-value text-danger">8.1%</div>
      <div class="kpi-subtext">26,581 flights (&gt; 60 min)</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

- **60.9%** departed early or on the exact scheduled minute.
- **17.6%** experienced minor adjustments under 15 minutes, which commercial airlines classify as on-time under FAA standard A14 metrics.
- **21.5%** incurred official delays exceeding 15 minutes.
- **8.1%** suffered acute disruptions exceeding 60 minutes.

---

### Official Delay Attribution (BTS Benchmark)

Official records from the **Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS)** and Federal Aviation Administration identify five core drivers of schedule delays:

```{=html}
<div class="row g-3 my-3">
  <div class="col-12 col-md-6">
    <div class="cause-item">
      <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-1">
        <strong style="color: #14283F; font-size: 13px;">1. Late-Arriving Aircraft (Network Propagation)</strong>
        <span class="font-mono text-muted small fw-bold">~38%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cause-bar-bg"><div class="cause-bar-fill" style="width: 38%; background-color: #287D9B;"></div></div>
      <div class="small text-secondary mt-2">Planes fly multiple route segments each day. Upstream inbound delays automatically cascade downstream to subsequent flights.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-12 col-md-6">
    <div class="cause-item">
      <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-1">
        <strong style="color: #14283F; font-size: 13px;">2. Air Carrier Operations</strong>
        <span class="font-mono text-muted small fw-bold">~30%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cause-bar-bg"><div class="cause-bar-fill" style="width: 30%; background-color: #287D9B;"></div></div>
      <div class="small text-secondary mt-2">Operational factors under carrier oversight: unscheduled maintenance, crew legal duty hour caps, ramp baggage handling, and cabin turnaround.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-12 col-md-6">
    <div class="cause-item">
      <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-1">
        <strong style="color: #14283F; font-size: 13px;">3. NAS &amp; Airspace Congestion</strong>
        <span class="font-mono text-muted small fw-bold">~24%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cause-bar-bg"><div class="cause-bar-fill" style="width: 24%; background-color: #263F57;"></div></div>
      <div class="small text-secondary mt-2">Air traffic control route spacing, high terminal-area density, ground delay programs (GDP), and airport surface taxiway queues.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-12 col-md-6">
    <div class="cause-item">
      <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-1">
        <strong style="color: #14283F; font-size: 13px;">4. Severe Weather Disruptions</strong>
        <span class="font-mono text-muted small fw-bold">~7%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cause-bar-bg"><div class="cause-bar-fill" style="width: 7%; background-color: #D69A43;"></div></div>
      <div class="small text-secondary mt-2">Meteorological events requiring airspace corridor rerouting or safety ground stops (thunderstorms, snowstorms, visibility minima).</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-12">
    <div class="cause-item">
      <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-1">
        <strong style="color: #14283F; font-size: 13px;">5. Security Breaches</strong>
        <span class="font-mono text-muted small fw-bold">&lt;1%</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cause-bar-bg"><div class="cause-bar-fill" style="width: 1%; background-color: #C65353;"></div></div>
      <div class="small text-secondary mt-2">Infrequent terminal concourse re-screenings or security perimeter hold procedures.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
